summary: Ansible 13 removed the community.digitalocean (1.27.0) and ibm.qradar (4.0.0) collections, which can still be installed manually.
questions: Which collections were removed in Ansible 13?
How can I still use community.digitalocean with Ansible 13?

answer_card.title: Collections removed in Ansible 13
answer_card.answer_md:
Removed from Ansible 13:

- community.digitalocean (was 1.27.0)
- ibm.qradar (was 4.0.0)

Install manually if needed: `ansible-galaxy collection install <name-of-collection>`.
